title: Super M
statementMd:
Ari the monster is not an ordinary monster. She is the hidden identity of Super M, the Byteforces’ superhero. Byteforces is a country that consists of $*n*$ cities, connected by $*n* - 1$ bidirectional roads. Every road connects exactly two distinct cities, and the whole road system is designed in a way that one is able to go from any city to any other city using only the given roads. There are $*m*$ cities being attacked by humans. So Ari... we meant Super M have to immediately go to each of the cities being attacked to scare those bad humans. Super M can pass from one city to another only using the given roads. Moreover, passing through one road takes her exactly one kron - the time unit used in Byteforces.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4e3c5e022beeabdc52eb7799fa23140cf3c6a39e.png)

However, Super M is not on Byteforces now - she is attending a training camp located in a nearby country Codeforces. Fortunately, there is a special device in Codeforces that allows her to instantly teleport from Codeforces to any city of Byteforces. The way back is too long, so for the purpose of this problem teleportation is used exactly once.

You are to help Super M, by calculating the city in which she should teleport at the beginning in order to end her job in the minimum time (measured in krons). Also, provide her with this time so she can plan her way back to Codeforces.

## Input

The first line of the input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *m* ≤ *n* ≤ 123456$) - the number of cities in Byteforces, and the number of cities being attacked respectively.

Then follow $*n* - 1$ lines, describing the road system. Each line contains two city numbers $*u*_{*i*}$ and $*v*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *u*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$) - the ends of the road $*i*$.

The last line contains $*m*$ distinct integers - numbers of cities being attacked. These numbers are given in no particular order.

## Output

First print the number of the city Super M should teleport to. If there are many possible optimal answers, print the one with the lowest city number.

Then print the minimum possible time needed to scare all humans in cities being attacked, measured in Krons.

Note that the correct answer is always unique.

## Note

In the first sample, there are two possibilities to finish the Super M's job in $3$ krons. They are:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/93d3c0306b529e9c2324f68158ca2156587473a2.png) and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/df80aa84591eaa7b9f52c88cc43b5f7da5bfead3.png).

However, you should choose the first one as it starts in the city with the lower number.
statementZhMd:
Ari 这只怪物并不是普通的怪物。她其实就是 Byteforces 的超级英雄 Super M 的隐藏身份。Byteforces 是一个由 $*n*$ 个城市组成的国家，这些城市由 $*n* - 1$ 条双向道路连接。每条道路恰好连接两个不同的城市，并且整个道路系统的设计保证了可以仅通过给定的道路从任意城市到达任意其他城市。有 $*m*$ 个城市正在遭受人类的袭击。因此 Ari……我们是说 Super M 必须立即前往每一个遭受袭击的城市，去吓跑那些坏人。Super M 只能通过给定的道路从一个城市前往另一个城市。此外，她通过一条道路恰好需要一个 kron——Byteforces 中使用的时间单位。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4e3c5e022beeabdc52eb7799fa23140cf3c6a39e.png)

然而，Super M 现在并不在 Byteforces——她正在邻国 Codeforces 参加训练营。幸运的是，Codeforces 中有一种特殊设备，可以让她从 Codeforces 瞬间传送到 Byteforces 的任意城市。回去的路太远了，因此在本题中传送恰好使用一次。

请你帮助 Super M，计算她在开始时应该传送到哪个城市，才能以最短时间（以 krons 为单位）完成任务。同时，也请计算出这个时间，以便她能够规划返回 Codeforces 的路线。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *m* ≤ *n* ≤ 123456$）——Byteforces 中的城市数量，以及正在遭受袭击的城市数量。

接下来 $*n* - 1$ 行描述道路系统。每行包含两个城市编号 $*u*_{*i}$ 和 $*v*_{*i}$（$1 ≤ *u*_{*i}, *v*_{*i} ≤ *n*$）——第 $*i*$ 条道路连接的两个端点。

最后一行包含 $*m*$ 个互不相同的整数——正在遭受袭击的城市编号。这些编号的给出顺序任意。

## 输出格式

首先输出 Super M 应该传送到的城市编号。如果有多个最优答案，输出编号最小的城市。

然后输出吓跑所有遭受袭击城市中的人类所需的最短时间，以 Krons 为单位。

注意，正确答案始终是唯一的。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，有两种方案可以用 $3$ 个 kron 完成 Super M 的任务。它们是：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/93d3c0306b529e9c2324f68158ca2156587473a2.png) 和 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/df80aa84591eaa7b9f52c88cc43b5f7da5bfead3.png)。

然而，你应该选择第一种方案，因为它从编号更小的城市出发。
